subject: RESTART after PC power loss (18:20): continue from your files
body: The PC lost power; all sessions died. Workers V40, IP, DEC01, DEC02, DEC03, DEC05, DEC06, DEC08 are restarted: READ your owned files + STATUS.md first, keep what passes, continue. Priority: V40 (output-buffer copy-back after each encoder GCE list: opus-hevc HIGH patch, 13 lines) and IP (separate-header fallback, HEVC level 4, rebuild vcodecd) are on the first-encode critical path; DEC05 (daemon decode service, use opus-dec1's dec1/vdec_ref.c and dec1/n2vcd_proto_dec_rev2.h.txt) and DEC06 (VideoToolbox decoder plug-in: use include/n2vt_dec_abi.h + facts/VT_DECODER_ABI.md) start now.
